## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

This bugfix adds an existing-invite-link check to `InviteLinkCalloutService.showIfEligible()` so the callout is skipped (and permanently dismissed) for organizations an admin has already configured, plus unit tests for the service branch and for the `ByLinkTabComponent` guided-tour guard. The new check is correctly ordered after the permission, feature-flag, and dismissal short-circuits, so it adds no extra request for users who already dismissed the callout. `OrganizationInviteLinkService` is registered in `jslib-services.module.ts` root providers, so the new `inject()` in this `providedIn: "root"` service resolves, and `DefaultOrganizationInviteLinkService.inviteLink$` already treats a 404 as "no link", which keeps the common no-link path working. Web tests, typecheck, and lint pass on CI; the failing `Rust deny` jobs are unrelated to this diff, which touches no Rust.
